A local story. Still being written.

A laptop. A vinyl cutter.
A bag of Doritos.
And a whole lot of drive.

That’s where this started: in Nik’s mom’s living room, cutting stickers for go-karts. Today, it’s a 4,000-square-foot creative and production shop on Main Street in Columbia.

The possibilities got bigger. The approach stayed simple. Listen to people. Make good work. Help the next idea become real.

Before we get started

A few good
questions.

Need a hand? That’s what we’re here for.

Talk to our team↗
Are Alley Cats and Copy Write part of Relevant?

Yes. Alley Cats Screen Printing and Copy Write Printing are part of our family of brands, alongside RD Graphics, Relevant Design, and Rocket Sites. Start with our team at 907 Main Street and we’ll help you find the right service.

Can you help if I don’t have artwork?

Absolutely. We can help turn an idea into a logo, a shirt design, a sign, or a full set of branded materials. Tell us what you need and we’ll include the appropriate design work in your quote.

How do I get a price?

Tell us the product or service, size, quantity, artwork needs, and your deadline. Print and signage prices depend on those details. We’ll review your project and provide a quote before production.

Do you work with businesses outside Columbia?

Yes. We’re based in Columbia, Mississippi and work with businesses, churches, schools, and organizations across Mississippi and beyond. Tell us your location so we can discuss delivery, installation, or a remote website project.

Can you help with both my storefront and my website?

Yes. Our print, signage, apparel, creative, and website services make it possible to carry the same identity from your storefront and team shirts to your online presence.
